messages:
michael: Pager alert triggered by metering-alerts — multiple customers reporting usage totals showing lower-than-expected values in the dashboard (UI only so far). Observed spike in 503s from /v1/usage-cache between 10:19–10:22 UTC. Root ts 1967801234.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT OPENED] severity: high | service: metering-ui | triggered_by: metering-alerts | incident_id: INC-20260315-01 | acknowledged by: ashley | started_at: 2026-03-15T10:20:34Z

ashley: i'm taking initial triage. jumping into the cache layer (redis-proxy and nginx cache). seeing a backlog of stale prefix entries. probable cache invalidation failing after a deploy ~10:15 UTC. tagging billing & cs. @sam-cs can you pull a quick list of impacted orgs?

sam-cs: pulling impacted list now. quick sample: orgs A, B, C show display mismatch where actual usage in ledger > dashboard by 5-15%. Drafting an outbound note for CS to use.

michael: run two quick checks for me: 1) tail metering-cache logs: `kubectl logs -l app=metering-cache -c cache --since=15m` 2) run reconciliation query: ```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(used_tokens) as ledger_tokens, dashboard_total
FROM billing.usage_ledger
WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY org_id, dashboard_total
HAVING SUM(used_tokens) - dashboard_total > 0;
```

jordan-oncall: oncall handoff: i'm on it for the next 4 hours. i've been paged in. I'll coordinate with infra to invalidate cache prefixes and re-run reconciliation job. If invalidation completes, we will push a quick status page update. @emily-cs please prepare the initial status.

devops-bot: deploy log: rollout of metering-cache v2.3.7 started at 2026-03-15T10:12Z. 95% success, 1 pod failed and restarted.

ashley: found root cause: the cache invalidation worker failed to connect to the job-queue after the v2.3.7 deploy due to a TLS config mismatch. Worker never processed invalidation events for ~10:13–10:25. Patch: reapply previous TLS secret to job-queue and restart workers. Performing restart now.

billing-bot: reconciliation job queued: job_id=rj-20260315-01 | target: rehydrate-dashboard | window: 10:00–10:30 UTC | expected_duration ~12m

emily-cs: DRAFT status page / customer note below. please review — I'll post when we have confirmation of mitigation.

emily-cs: STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
- Impact: Dashboard usage totals may appear lower than actual for a subset of customers between 10:12–10:25 UTC. Invoices were not charged incorrectly; ledger data is correct.
- Current status: Mitigation in progress — cache invalidation and reconciliation jobs running.
- Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner once dashboard counts reconcile.

emily-cs: CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT (short):
Hi — we detected an issue that caused recent dashboard usage totals to be temporarily out-of-sync for some accounts between 10:12–10:25 UTC today. Your billed usage is correct and there will be no impact on invoices. We are correcting the dashboard display now and expect counts to reconcile within the hour. We'll follow up when it's resolved. — Redwood Inference Support

michael: +1 to that copy. Also suggest adding a note: "No action required from customers; data is correct in the ledger."

ashley: invalidation restart completed at 10:29 UTC. Observed worker reconnect logs: `INFO connected to job-queue` and `processed 120 invalidation events`. Pushing metric: cache_stale_rate down from 18% -> 2% across active shards.

billing-bot: reconciliation job completed at 10:37 UTC — reconciled 98% of affected rows. Remaining ~2% under investigation (edge cases where event processing latency exceeded 5 minutes).

jordan-oncall: visual spot check on dashboards for sample orgs A, B, C — totals match ledger now. Will continue to monitor metrics and set a 1h watch.

sam-cs: CS template updated and queued to send to impacted customers if counts don't reconcile by 11:30 UTC. For now will hold outbound until we confirm full reconciliation.

emily-cs: posting initial status page now. Copy used: same as draft + link to this incident thread for internal follow-up.

devops-bot: deployment note: rolled back TLS secret change for job-queue at 10:28:45Z.

michael: action items captured: 1) infra to add preflight TLS validation in deploy pipeline (assigned to ashley) 2) add automated alert when invalidation worker processes 0 events for >5m (assigned to eng-sre) 3) post-incident RCA doc (assigned to michael + billing).

ashley: quick follow-up: i'll open a PR for pipeline check and link in the ticket.

emily-cs: CS will prepare the customer communication for any orgs still impacted after 11:30 UTC. Template is ready.

michael: final update for thread — mitigation successful, dashboards reconciled for 98% and remainder being tracked. We'll publish RCA & postmortem once we finish root cause analysis (expected EOD). Closing incident in status page, leaving internal incident ticket open for RCA.

jordan-oncall: handing off monitoring to oncall rotation at 11:00 UTC. Leaving notes in PagerDuty (INC-20260315-01).

sam-cs: noted, will reopen thread if any delayed invoices or customer reports come in. :eyes:

michael: thanks team.
